Report_ID: Acute Kidney Injury (AKIN serum creatinine criteria, stages 1-2)
Title: Epoetin administrated after cardiac surgery: effects on renal function and inflammation in a randomized controlled study
Author: de Seigneux S, Ponte B, Weiss L, Pugin J, Romand JA, Martin PY, Saudan P
Comment: The reported p=0.53 is a chi-square comparing all three randomized groups, not the pooled ESA vs placebo 2x2 comparison. Event counts for the pooled ESA arm (11/40) were obtained by summing the two EPO dose arms as instructed by the synthesis plan; no pooled test statistic is reported by the paper. One patient was transferred at 48 h but was known not to have developed AKI, so intention-to-treat denominators of 40/40 are retained.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('α-Epoetin intravenously (20,000 IU n=20 + 40,000 IU n=20, pooled)') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Participant type: Adults (>18 years) admitted to ICU after elective cardiac surgery, at risk of acute kidney injury
Recruitment source: Intensive care unit, University Hospital of Geneva, Switzerland (2008-2009)
Outcome measurement: Number of participants developing AKI (AKIN serum creatinine criteria) out of number randomised per arm; two EPO dose arms combined (5/20 + 6/20 = 11/40)
Outcome variable: Acute Kidney Injury (AKIN serum creatinine criteria, stages 1-2)
additional_group_ns: Three-arm trial: Control n=40 (7 AKI, 17.5%); EPO 20,000 IU n=20 (5 AKI, 25%); EPO 40,000 IU n=20 (6 AKI, 30%). The two EPO dose arms were summed into a single ESA arm (11/40) per the synthesis plan; no arms were excluded.
follow_up_timepoint: in-hospital / ICU or early postoperative stay (3 days to discharge)

Report_ID: Postoperative AKI (modified RIFLE definition), number of patients

Author: Yoo YC, Shim JK, Kim JC, Jo YY, Lee JH, Kwak YL
Comment: Denominators are the numbers analysed for AKI as printed in Table 5 (control 35, rHuEPO 37), which are smaller than the 37 randomised per arm in the control group; the paper does not explain this discrepancy. Author: Askenazi DJ
Comment: Per-arm any-AKI event counts were derived by summing the Table II stage 1+2+3 cells (placebo 105+47+28=180; rhEpo 78+61+32=171; total 351 matches the stated 351/923).
